description:
We are a team of five students aged 13-14 from Lyceum No.2 in Drohobych, Ukraine. Our team consists of three girls and two boys. We are passionate about astronomy, space exploration, and the latest discoveries in the universe. We are curious, creative, and enjoy solving mysteries and working together.

Our motto: " Explore Space. Discover the Unknown!"
summary: The main goal of our project is to make learning about space more engaging, interactive, and enjoyable. By combining entertainment with education, we encourage curiosity, teamwork, logical thinking, and interest in science. Our game offers an accessible way for children, families, and space enthusiasts to learn more about humanity’s exploration of the Moon.
details: Our project is a science-fiction story about five students traveling on the moon. The reader is getting transported in adventure with students.Our goal is to make astronomy and space science more accessible and interesting, especially for young people.The project was developed through creative planning, game design, and educational research. We focused on creating a clear game structure, an attractive visual concept, and an engaging space exploration theme.The creative aspect of our project is the combination of a familiar story format with the history of the Apollo missions and lunar exploration. We transformed a traditional family story into an educational space adventure.
